text: Implemented incremental reindexing for the catalog search shard
Squashed a duplicate-write bug in the catalog shard writer
Chose an append-only segment layout for the catalog shard
Capped the append-only segment retention at seven days for the catalog shard
Trimmed the signup wizard down to four screens
Released the trimmed signup wizard behind a rollout flag
Kept advanced-preferences reachable via a toggle rather than deleting it
The advanced-preferences screen buried the primary action and drove most signup abandonment
A variant hiding advanced-preferences behind a single toggle was sketched as the fix
Sporadic gateway throttling under bursty upload traffic was traced to a quota counter that only refreshed on a fixed minute boundary
Replaced the fixed-boundary quota counter with a continuously-draining counter
Load-generated bursty uploads at three times the prior ceiling with zero false throttles
Built a daily digest email combining unread notifications
Chose a 24-hour rolling window instead of calendar-day boundaries
Added a per-user quiet-hours setting that delays digest send
Load-tested digest generation for 50k users and confirmed under 2 minutes
Capped digest batch size at 500 notifications per email
Fixed a timezone bug in the quiet-hours calculation
Standardized all quiet-hours math on UTC internally, converting only for display
Added a regression test pinning the UTC+9 case
The timezone bug silently suppressed digests for users east of UTC+9 for about two weeks
